title: identity
description: The identity scene and the likeness check (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8c): the face sidecar they call and how long the identity scene waits for the image engine.

max_wait_s.description: Seconds the identity scene waits for the image engine, queue time included.

face_service.description: The CPU face sidecar. It is config data, not a registry service: where to reach it and how its lifecycle driver starts it (the same keys a service record's lifecycle takes). Absent means not configured. It holds no secret.
